senses.gloss:
Kinnaras
(‘Are they human beings?’)
------------------------------------------
The किन्नरस् considered among the demigods are the opposite of the किम्पुरुषस् in that they have human bodies and heads of horses.
They are the offsprings of the sage कश्यप in his wife Surasā.
They inhabit the world of कुबेर, the god of wealth.
